title: Choose the visual world for Cheming.Site
question: The roll assigned Pipe Marker. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pipe Marker
options.lineage: ASME A13.1 pipe-marking bands and plant safety signage
options.thesis: Every tool is labelled like a line in the plant: a colour band, a tag and a flow arrow.
options.viewport: Carbon header with the name and a tool search; below it, the 26 tools as marker labels in five colour bands (Relief & Flare red, Piping & Flow blue, Equipment orange, Properties purple, General grey). The usage legend shows input and output as yellow and green markers, the only place those colours appear outside the Zoho sheets.
options.risk: Full-strength bands can tip into safety-poster kitsch; colour must stay inside the bands and never wash the page.

raised.raise: Tool abbreviations (PSV, KOD, CV, RO) are set at display scale against small labels; hierarchy comes from scale contrast.
Focusing a tool reveals its standard and one-line description in place, without moving its neighbours.
Tool pages show related tools as upstream/downstream flow along a marker arrow (PSV → KOD → Flare Stack).
The index reflows by whole label cells, never by half-width cards.
The index runs at one type size; rank comes from weight, case and white-on-band reversal.

options.label: Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: P&ID drawing sheets: ISA instrument bubbles, line numbers, title blocks
options.thesis: The site reads as a clean drawing sheet, with each tool tagged like an instrument.
materials: ISA tag bubbles (PSV, KOD) for tools
a title block carrying the disclaimer
options.viewport: A white sheet with a thin border and zone marks; tools grouped by category, each with a circular tag bubble and its full name; a title-block footer holds the name, disclaimer and contact.
options.risk: This is the familiar 'engineering' look most sites in this space reach for; it can read as a blueprint costume.

options.label: Handbook Plate
options.lineage: 19th-century lexicon pages, read as an engineering handbook (Perry's, GPSA)
options.thesis: The site is a reference handbook: black text, a thumb index, and each calculator set as a colour plate.
materials: guide words at the page head
bordered plate around each Zoho sheet
options.viewport: Index page with guide words (Compressor … Unit Conversion), a thumb index by category in the margin, and entries ranked by apparatus (full name, standard, one line).
options.case: Fuses cleanly: colour stays quarantined inside the plate, which suits the Zoho sheets; strong for students. Loses on audience identification for practising engineers.
options.risk: Can turn bookish and slow for an engineer who just wants PSV now.

options.label: Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Tools as stations on coloured lines.
options.viewport: A network map of the 26 tools.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the map replaces a scannable list for 26 items, and the General tools have no natural line.
options.kept: Related tools shown as an upstream/downstream flow.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.viewport: One giant tool abbreviation per screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience link; one tool per screen slows the finder.
options.kept: Scale contrast: abbreviations at display size.

options.label: Catalog Wall
options.case: Fuses poorly: horizontal rows hide tools that should all be visible at once.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: A visible construction grid as the page's armature.
options.viewport: Tools as cells on a visible grid.
options.case: Fuses fairly: grids are engineering-adjacent, but the pipe-marker world is closer to the plant.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight and reversal.
options.viewport: The tool list as a raked timetable.
options.case: Fuses poorly: raked containers fight the wide Zoho sheets.
options.kept: One type size in the index, rank by weight, case and reversal.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean online-calculator directory, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Search at the top, tools as cards grouped by category, a simple header and footer.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other calculator site by design.
